result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed, but there are a few visual defects: the 'Orders' tab in the bottom navigation is missing its icon, a restaurant name is truncated without an ellipsis, and a category chip is awkwardly clipped at the screen edge.

issues.description: The 'Orders' item in the bottom navigation bar has a text label but no icon, while Home, Search, and Profile all display icons. This makes the nav bar look broken and inconsistent.
issues.suggestion: Add the missing Orders icon (e.g., a receipt or bag glyph) above the label, matching the size and style of the other nav icons.

issues.description: The restaurant name 'Trattoria Piccol' in the 'Fastest near you' carousel is hard-clipped mid-word at the screen edge with no ellipsis, appearing broken rather than intentionally truncated.
issues.suggestion: Apply ellipsis truncation within the card's own width instead of letting the text run to the viewport edge, or size the card so the title wraps/truncates cleanly.

issues.description: A category chip after 'Healthy' is clipped at the right edge showing only a thin sliver, which looks like a rendering glitch rather than a scroll affordance.
issues.suggestion: Adjust chip spacing/peek amount so the next chip is visibly partially shown (e.g., 30–40% visible) to clearly signal horizontal scrollability.

issues.description: The last pizza card in 'Popular right now' is cut off by the bottom navigation with its title and details hidden, and the nav bar appears to have no visible top border/shadow separating it from the clipped content.
issues.suggestion: Add a subtle top border or elevation shadow to the bottom nav bar to visually separate it from scrolling content.
